verdicts.title: Bounded cumulative observables from local linear relaxation
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Cumulative observables often exhibit saturation in systems involving propagation or spreading with local dissipation. This work shows that bounded cumulative response follows directly from local linear relaxation.
